suite: qwen voice frontend route-C enforcement restored
userReport: 「当前环境未配置所需后台代理支持」— 听起来像开了 qwen audio

rootCause.what: The shell sets NISSE_ROUTE_C=1 and NISSE_BRIDGE_ONLY=1, but the voice runtime path had been switched to research/qwen-audio-agent, an older checkout that lacks our route-C guard patches. The realtime voice frontend therefore still exposed its own execution tools (spawn_thinking/cancel_agent_task/schedule/...). When the realtime model tried one of them, the qwen tool runtime answered with its canned '当前未配置后台 Agent，无法执行…' text and the model spoke a paraphrase: 「当前环境未配置所需后台代理支持」.
rootCause.notFromDsh: Decompressed all DSH sessions under /tmp/whalegirl-demo: the phrase does not exist there. It was generated by the qwen voice frontend, confirming the user's suspicion.

syncedIntoResearchCheckout: server/src/core/config.mjs (route-C startup guard + bridge-only tool disable)
effect: the realtime model sees only the control-plane tools (respond_permission / respond_agent_input); no execution tools, no dynamic/client tool sources
NISSE_BRIDGE_ONLY removes spawn_thinking / cancel_agent_task; route-C hard-fails startup if memory provider or backend agent is configured
user turns are delegated by the runtime straight to the DSH bridge (delegateUserTurns) — qwen does not generate content or execute anything; it is only ASR/TTS/voice I/O

verification.gateway: runs with NISSE_ROUTE_C=1 and NISSE_BRIDGE_ONLY=1, backend=none, error="" (stable)
verification.routeC_e2e: m4/bot-evidence/ROUTE-C-E2E.json — text message 「帮我创建一个明天早上9点的定时任务，提醒我喝水。」 reached the real DSH session bf3ecc4e… turn 13 (user.message → assistant.message → turn.ended completed); the same transcript is in the DSH session log. No qwen-generated answer, no backend-agent error.
verification.messageAbsence: the phrase no longer appears anywhere in bridge events; it cannot be produced because the tool that emitted it is not exposed in route C.

abortMisreport.userReport: route-C 修完后仍然听到「后台暂时不可用」
abortMisreport.rootCause: 说第二句/碰键鼠时，上一轮语音 turn 被中断（abort）。bridge-turn 把 'aborted' 当成 DSH 桥断线，走了 route-C 的 fail-closed 文案「后台暂时不可用，我不会自己执行。」——实际 DSH 是好的，只是上一轮被取消。日志证据：2026-10-23T05:00:16 gateway.log nisse.bridge_turn_failed error=aborted spoke=false → speak preview 后台暂时不可用。
abortMisreport.fix: bridge-turn 现在把 AbortError/aborted 归类为 cancelled（与 stop/barge-in 相同）：只记 nisse.bridge_turn_cancelled，不再说后台不可用、也不再发错误气泡；只有真正 discovery/SSE 失败才说「后台暂时不可用」。
abortMisreport.verification: 长任务（统计 /tmp + 写报告）进行中用 bridge /cancel 取消：cancelResult.cancelled=true，gateway 日志出现 nisse.bridge_turn_cancelled phase=aborted，backendUnavailableSpoken=false（未朗读后台不可用）。
abortMisreport.also: 清理了一只复用旧 gateway 的僵死桌宠进程（client_occupied），并重启为单一 app+pet+gateway。
